title: Global growth forecast at 3.1% in 2026 amid shocks: IMF
content:
The IMF has kept its global growth outlook broadly unchanged from April, projecting activity to expand 3.1 per cent in 2026 and 3.4 per cent in 2027 despite persistent energy disruption. 
Headline inflation is forecast at 4.7 per cent in 2026 before easing to 4.1 per cent in 2027. 
It urged countries to rebuild fiscal buffers, supply resilience and predictable trade rules.

title: Canada leads biggest India trade mission as CEPA advances
content:
Canada is leading nearly 300 delegates on its biggest India trade mission in over 30 years, as it pursues a trade pact by end-2026. 
The five-sector mission spans clean tech, ICT, life sciences, aerospace and agri-food, as Ottawa targets $70 billion in trade by 2030. 
In 2025, Canada’s goods exports to India were $3.9 billion and imports $9.7 billion; direct investment there reached $11.4 billion.

title: India & UK seek to double trade by 2030 under CETA
content:
India and the UK have been urged to use CETA to double bilateral trade by 2030, turning market access into exports, investment, partnerships and jobs.
Piyush Goyal said CETA gives zero-duty UK access for most Indian exports, including textiles and leather goods, and opens opportunities for UK exporters.
Both sides also called for clear guidance on tariffs, origin rules and customs procedures.

title: India must leverage FTAs, textiles to boost exports & jobs: Goyal
content:
India's Minister of Commerce Piyush Goyal said India must combine access to advanced global technologies with job creation and business growth. 
Highlighting FTAs and strengths in textiles, footwear, agriculture and food processing, he stressed exports, quality standards and global partnerships to support India’s ambition of becoming a developed nation by 2047.

title: South Indian cotton yarn firms as higher fibre prices lift sentiment
content:
South India's cotton yarn sentiment improved as Mumbai prices rose ₹5–8 (~$0.05–0.08) per kg on stock replenishment, while Tiruppur held steady after last week's ₹2–3 gains.
Gujarat cotton jumped another ₹2,000 per candy on sustained mill buying and stronger ICE cotton futures, despite rising new-season arrivals.
Mills sought new cotton for blending with lower-quality old-season stocks.

title: India & UK to exchange annual data on CETA business use
content:
India and the UK used the 16th JETCO in New Delhi to review Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA) implementation and agree priorities for the year ahead, including annual data sharing on pact use. 
Indian exporters sent more than 50 consignments to the UK when CETA took effect, including ready-made garments and woollen yarn. 
The 17th JETCO will be held in the UK in 2027.

title: UK trade mission to India targets $1.32 bn, boosts retail expansion
content:
A UK trade mission to India has secured over $1.32 billion in business deals across retail, engineering, aviation, technology and healthcare. 
British kidswear brand Angel & Rocket plans 100 stores in India over five years, targeting £43 million ($56.76 million) in revenue and 500 jobs. 
Deals announced since the UK-India FTA was signed in July 2025 have reached nearly £12 billion.

title: Is caprolactam duty risk: Can nylon yarn makers absorb the shock?
content:
India has opened an anti-dumping probe into caprolactam from China, Russia, Thailand and the US after GSFC's complaint.
The case lands on a stable nylon chain that is short of demand, with Ahmedabad prices about 17 per cent above Chinese FOB cargoes.
Imports jumped from 20,440 tonnes in 2023 to 69,351 tonnes in 2025, while weak weaving leaves mills with little room to pass on any duty.

title: Bangladesh aligns economic reform priorities with World Bank, IMF
content:
Bangladesh has reached broad policy alignment with the World Bank and IMF on economic reforms to restore financial stability, boost tax revenue, expand social protection and create jobs, Adviser Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir said. 
The government also plans to reopen closed factories, attract investment, strengthen energy security and expand trade ties with Thailand.
